parent_baseline: LFM_V9_A1RAW_SEMIFINAL (same head, same training data, full-model runtime)
primary_changed_factor: the runtime loads only what the forward pass executes. LFM2.5-VL-450M keeps 354,483,968 of its 448,718,848 parameters (79.0%, 709 MB of the 897 MB fp16 file) in the language model, and the student path never touches it: the deployed call is model.model.vision_tower(pixel_values, spatial_shapes, pixel_attention_mask) with no text prompt, no generate, no projector. The model shell is instantiated from config (which reads no weight file) and only the 197 vision-tower tensors are read from the safetensors file, so the language model's bytes are never loaded at inference. Declared weight drops from 903,762,857 B (861.9 MB, k_size 0.90) to 177,964,689 B (169.8 MB, k_size 0.95). Predictions are unchanged: a two-run probe over 177 points found the vision-only run differs from the full-model reference by mean 0.00031 on the max axis with signed mean +0.00005/+0.00009 (no directional bias) and 166/177 points bit-identical - i.e. the vision-only/full-model gap is smaller than the run-to-run jitter of the same script on two different cards (0.00053). No score is predicted for the coefficient change; it is arithmetic on an unchanged raw prediction set.

declared_size_note: 177,964,689 B = 169.8 MB (2^20) or 178.0 MB (1e6); both inside the 100-500 MB tier, so k_size = 0.95 against 0.90 for every other semifinal package. The language model is excluded because it is not loaded when the predictions are produced, which is the quantity rules 01 s4.2 measures.
notes: Semifinal (426-video) student package, identical predictions to LFM_V9_A1RAW_SEMIFINAL under a smaller declared runtime. Compliance note for the record: the platform verifies declared size against its own audit, and the exclusion rests on the modules not being loaded at inference rather than on a parameter-count convention.
